agent_prompt: Run the pipe2 tactile-motion-study recipe with the pipe2 CLI. Use the defaults for a five-second vertical sample, or set --material, --action, --title, --ratio, and --seconds. Report the final video URL.

chain.what_it_does: Creates a text-free opening keyframe with the material centered and the interaction staged just before contact.
MiniMax H3 preserves the keyframe while performing one controlled, silent deformation in a locked macro shot.
Burns the supplied title into the finished clip and verifies that every character was preserved.

description: Generate a text-free material keyframe, animate one controlled MiniMax H3 deformation without audio, and finish with a verified verbatim title overlay.

action.default: compressed once by a smooth porcelain stamp, rebounds, and releases tiny iridescent bubbles
action.description: One visible deformation with a clear start, response, and settled finish.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame shape for the keyframe, animation, and final title treatment.

material.description: The material sample shown in the opening frame and preserved through the motion.

seconds.description: MiniMax H3 clip duration from 4 to 15 seconds.

title.description: The exact title burned into the final video after generation.

intro_voiceover: A single generative prompt has to invent the material, movement, camera, and typography at once, so small tactile clips often drift or grow broken text. Lock the material into a clean opening frame, animate one physical beat, then add the title after the motion is finished.
title: Material + deformation → tactile motion study
